content: Ungö apan, mɛ kàmɛn un'kyeey asin wàngwal kàyàtyà fà du. Nde kàkäl aŋàfwe itööm mwɛy anà unkwal a mbul kà un'tswe ande. Ntabwey ande yàkäl asànaa taaŋ anà in'kɔl ande myàkäl asànaa an'ta a mbaa.
Nde kàkäärà kikaan aŋàduub. Nde kàtɔl làkɔl ande là ibaal udu a ngyäl anà làkɔl ande là ikaar u mɛɛn.
Nde kàsi in'kwɛŋ a ngwal, asànaa ntaamà awàmuŋan. Ungö a nde musà in'kwɛŋ, ipar nsambwaar byàsi in'dum.
Mpal byàmay ipar muböl, mɛ kàlàkwen musɔn, wɛɛ mɛ kàwem ndaa yan'fà du yàmutɛn a mɛ naa: « Yee indiir byan'tɛn ipar nsambwaar, twon an'sɔn bya. »
Apan, un'kyeey awà kàmɛn mɛ wàŋàmbar udu a ngyäl anà udu a mɛɛn kàsɛn kɔɔ ande là ibaal u du.
Nde kàdi kyän là, u mbwo a mbuur awe anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, awà kàkyer du, mɛɛn, ngyäl anà indiir abyà uboo mwo: « Taaŋ afàdil latɛy!
Umpal usàbɛɛrà un'kyeey wànsambwaar mfuŋ, apan Nzam asàkwey ngyee ande, asànaa kàkyään nde ya akà asyääl ande aŋangɔɔm. »
Ungö apan, ndaa ayà kàwem mɛ fà du yàfàtɛn a mɛ abà: « Kyen kawɛl kikaan aŋàduub kà an'kɔɔ a un'kyeey awà umbäär udu a ngyäl anà udu a mɛɛn. »
Mɛ kàsin tsütsü apà un'kyeey, waa kun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m mukan'pà kikaan kya. Nde kan'fuur naa: « Wal kya anà dyà kya: wa asàkal buul ntɔn kwiy angye, wɛɛ u mun angye wa asàkal ntsà asànaa bwey. »
Mɛ kàwɛl kikaan akin kà an'kɔɔ a un'kyeey, waa kàdi kya. U mun amɛ kya kyàkäl ntsà asànaa bwey. Wɛɛ ungö mumin kya, kya kyàbulà buul ntɔn kwiy amɛ.
Apan, bàtɛn a mɛ naa: « Ngye akyer afàtà ngɔɔm udu a in'sɛŋ, nsi, ndaa anà amfum mbɔɔn. »
